professionalSummary: Servicing team leader at Calderbrook Building Society since October 2021, leading nine administrators handling payment changes, redemption statements and arrears letters for residential mortgage accounts.
Managed month‑end arrears processing, ensuring timely letter runs and escalation of exceptions to the collections manager.
Monitored quality‑check results and conducted refresher coaching when recurring errors were identified.
Updated servicing procedures following regulatory or policy changes and trained the team on revised steps.
Holds a recognised mortgage qualification (CeMAP) verified by the awarding body.
experienceHighlights: Led a team of nine administrators, overseeing daily work‑allocation meetings and maintaining a two‑day service standard for redemption statements during peak periods.
Prepared month‑end arrears letter runs, reviewed exception reports for vulnerable accounts, and coordinated escalation decisions with the collections manager.
Reviewed monthly quality‑check results, identified recurring redemption‑calculation errors, and ran refresher sessions to reduce error rates.
Updated payment‑holiday procedure notes after the 2022 policy change and conducted team walkthroughs to ensure compliance.
projectsAndWorkSamples: An anonymised monthly quality‑check summary detailing sample sizes, error categories, recurring redemption‑calculation errors, and dates of refresher sessions.

evidence.text: Servicing team leader at Calderbrook Building Society, October 2021 to present, leading nine administrators who process payment changes, redemption statements and arrears letters for residential mortgage accounts.
Ran the daily work-allocation meeting and moved cases between queues to keep redemption statements inside the two-day service standard during the spring remortgage peak.
HR verification note: the candidate's CeMAP certificate was checked with the awarding body's qualification verification service and is recorded as awarded in March 2019.

Prepared the month-end arrears letter run in the servicing system, checked the exception report for accounts with vulnerability markers or disputed balances, and passed those exceptions to the collections manager for decision.
Ran the daily work-allocation meeting and moved cases between queues to keep redemption statements inside the two-day service standard during the spring remortgage peak.
Reviewed the team's monthly quality-check results and ran refresher sessions on redemption calculations whenever the same error appeared three times in a month.

Work sample: an anonymised monthly quality-check summary for the team, giving sample sizes, error categories, the three recurring redemption-calculation errors and the dates of the refresher sessions that followed.
Updated the payment-holiday procedure notes after the 2022 policy change and walked the team through the revised steps at the Monday huddle.
